passages.title: Facilities policy: parking
passages.heading: Standard monthly parking allowance
passages.meta: version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-09-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-23
passages.text: Employees who drive to the office receive a monthly parking allowance of 90 EUR. The facilities publishes worked examples of the monthly parking allowance on the intranet. The facilities reviews the monthly parking allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.title: Facilities policy: parking
passages.heading: Standard monthly parking allowance
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-11
passages.text: Employees who drive to the office receive a monthly parking allowance of 60 EUR. Claims for the monthly parking allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Facilities policy: parking'. The facilities reviews the monthly parking allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.title: Memo: monthly parking allowance exceptions
passages.heading: Exception for employees at the city-centre office
passages.text: For employees at the city-centre office, the monthly parking allowance is 110 EUR per month instead of the standard amount. The facilities reviews the monthly parking allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Each claim for the monthly parking allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.title: Memo: monthly parking allowance exceptions
passages.heading: Purpose
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the monthly parking allowance in HB-23. Questions about the monthly parking allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions. Managers confirm claims for the monthly parking allowance before payment in the next payroll run.
